newsitem.title: USA: Queens County to repurchase 500,000 shares.
newsitem.headline: Queens County to repurchase 500,000 shares.

text.p: Queens County Bancorp Inc said Wednesday it plans to repurchase up to 500,000 shares of additional common stock.
The company said in January it authorized the repurchase of 1.5 million shares (adjusted for a three-for-two stock split in April), of which 233,735 shares remain available for repurchase.
Combined, Queens County said, the 733,735 shars represent 7.21 percent of the 10,178,649 shares currently outstanding.

The company said the shares will be repurchased in either the open market or by negotiated transactions and the number of shares repurchased will depend on market conditions and other strategies designed to enhance shareholder value.
